newsitem.title: USA: El Paso files plan for Tenneco deal.
newsitem.headline: El Paso files plan for Tenneco deal.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp and Tenneco Inc said on Tuesday that they have filed documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission to support their previously announced plans to merge El Paso with Tenneco's Energy unit.
The $4 billion merger plan is awaiting a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service on the tax-free nature of the deal.

When the deal is complete, Tenneco shareholders will receive 0.1 El Paso shares for each share of current Tenneco stock, based on El Paso's current share price and 174.3 million Tenneco shares outstanding, the companies said.
